dct_description_sm: Shows major westward trails from 1785 to 1866: Old Oregon Trail and its deviations, Old Spanish Trail, Lewis and Clark route, Santa Fe Trail, Fremont's Trail, Mormon Trail, Naches Pass Trail, Overland Stage Route, Pony Express, Bozeman Trail, and Butterfields Denver Stage.; Relief shown pictorially.; Pictorial map.; "Issued by the American Pioneer Trails Association in connection with the 1948 Old Oregon Centennial."; "Printed by The Clarke Press, Manchester, N.H."; Includes historic notes.
1 map : color 38 x 60 cm, on sheet 46 x 64 cm
